title_sq: SHES AMBIENT KOMERCIAL PRANE SHESHIT WILLSON
description_sq:
Prane sheshit Willson shes ambient komercial shume i pershtatshem per investim afatgjate.
Ambienti ka siperfaqe neto 78 m si dhe nje verande prej 8m.
Esht i dhene me qira , ne vlere te konsiderushme.
Ambienti eshte i investuar, ofrohet ne shitje me investimin dhe pajisjet brenda.
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: FOR SALE COMMERCIAL ENVIRONMENT NEAR WILLSON SQUARE
description_en: Near Wilson Square, I am selling a commercial space very suitable for long-term investment. The environment has a net surface of 78 m and a veranda of 8 m. It is given for rent, at a considerable value. The environment is invested, it is offered for sale with the investment and the equipment inside. The property has regular mortgage documentation.
